combo1.title: Gulgolet and Kambi into Darklord Eveningstar and Purification Power Patron
combo1.description: Going first with no interaction: Dawn Angel Kambi and Darklord Djehuty start the line, Trickstar Bloom and Condemned Darklord turn Gulgolet's searches into Darklord Eveningstar and Purification Power Patron, and the turn ends with Darklord Rebellion, Banishment of the Darklords and Forbidden Droplet Set.

combo2.title: Going First Through Maxx "C", Effect Veiler and Infinite Impermanence
combo2.description: Ash Blossom answers Maxx "C", then Effect Veiler hits Darklord Ixchel and Infinite Impermanence hits Indulged Darklord. Banishment of the Darklords, Ixchel's draw and Darklord Contact still reach S:P Little Knight with The Sanctified Darklord Set. Inf's big turn is turn 3 of the full duel.

combo3.title: Going Second: Forbidden Droplet into The First Darklord OTK
combo3.description: Against an Adventurer board, Forbidden Droplet opens the turn and Solemn Strike stops Gulgolet. Darklord Dance, Darklord Contact, Morningstar and Mutiny in the Sky still build Mediclius the Extraordinary Power Patron and The First Darklord, which attack for game on turn 2.
